source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingAttachmentRetrievalOptionEnumTest { @isTest static void enumMethods() { Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption metadataOnly = Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_ONLY; Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption metadataWithBody = Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_WITH_BODY; Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption none = Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.NONE; System.assertEquals(Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_ONLY, metadataOnly); System.assertEquals(Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_WITH_BODY, metadataWithBody); System.assertEquals(Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.NONE, none); System.assertEquals(0, metadataOnly.ordinal()); System.assertEquals(1, metadataWithBody.ordinal()); System.assertEquals(2, none.ordinal()); List<Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption> values = Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.values(); System.assertEquals(3, values.size()); System.assertEquals(metadataOnly, values[0]); System.assertEquals(metadataWithBody, values[1]); System.assertEquals(none, values[2]); System.assertEquals(metadataOnly, Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.valueOf('METADATA_ONLY')); System.assertEquals(metadataWithBody, Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.valueOf('METADATA_WITH_BODY')); System.assertEquals(none, Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.valueOf('NONE')); System.assert(metadataOnly.equals(metadataOnly)); System.assert(metadataOnly.equals(Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.valueOf('METADATA_ONLY'))); System.assert(!metadataOnly.equals(metadataWithBody)); System.assert(!metadataOnly.equals(null)); Integer hash = metadataOnly.hashCode(); System.assertNotEquals(null, hash); System.assertEquals(hash, metadataOnly.hashCode()); } }
